correctness.rationale: The six-dimensional Jacobian for two axis-cross-product matrices splits on (v,±Rv) under R=diag(-1,-1,1) into two 3x3 blocks. Independent symbolic charpolys match P_+(z)=z³+4hz²+(4h²+ω²)z+2hω² sin²(theta/2) and P_-(z)=z³+2hz²+ω²z+2hω² cos²(theta/2) with z=lambda-1 and h=K/2. Cubic strict Routh-Hurwitz coefficients plus the submitted E>0 comparison reduce stability to K>3 and L<u<U. U-L=(K-3)/K*(1-(2K-3)/ω²); 0<L<U<1 iff omega²>2K-3; minimizing over K and imposing u=1/2 gives omega>sqrt(3) and omega>4sqrt(2). Independent numerical eigenspectra agreed for stable K=4,omega=3,u=.8 and K=6,omega=6,u=.5, unstable K=4,u=.5; smooth local exponential stability iff Hurwitz, no boundary/global assertion.
